text:
Nina Park: Heads-up 9— a bunch of tenants saw conflicting client errors during a routing failover. Console badge toggled bright red for some and amber for others. We should agree on a compact error shape + telemetry that also covers quota headroom and accessibility-friendly badge variants.

Owen Hsu: Agreed. Minimal contract idea: client_status (OK|RETRYABLE|THROTTLED|FAILED), reason_code (RATE_LIMIT|TIMEOUT|MODEL_OOM|BACKEND), route_category (primary|fallback|quantized), retry_after_ms opt, visibility (public|internal), visible_message_key opt. Keep visible_message only when visibility=public.

Felix Martin: Add tenant_headroom_pct as an optional numeric tag for console (helps badge show near-capacity warnings). But mark it as sampled/aggregated to avoid PII/high-cardinality. Also add badge_color_key for WCAG-friendly palettes (e.g., badge_color_key: "status.warning_high_contrast").

Nina Park: Good call. Example payload for SDKs and server teams:```json
{"error":{"client_status":"THROTTLED","reason_code":"RATE_LIMIT","retry_after_ms":45000,"route_category":"fallback","visibility":"public","visible_message_key":"quota.tenant.limited","tenant_headroom_pct":"3"}}
```

Owen Hsu: SDK mapping rules: THROTTLED -> ThrottleError with retry_after accessor; RETRYABLE -> RetryableError; FAILED -> FatalError. If client_status absent, fall back to legacy (429->THROTTLED, 5xx->FAILED). For visible_message_key, SDK should prefer locale bundle resolution; if missing, show a short generic message.

Felix Martin: Telemetry names to standardize: event.client_status, event.reason_code, metric.tenant_headroom_pct (sampled), facet.route_category, tag.tenant_bucket, tag.visible_message_key. Console will use metric.tenant_headroom_pct to surface "near capacity" amber states before full throttle.

deploy-bot: Canary toggle applied: feature-flag: client-surface-v2 at 2024-07-12T12:00Z for eng-platform.

Nina Park: Rollout plan: per-tenant flag. Step 1: 5% sampled traffic + raw_error sampling for 48h. Step 2: 25% with aggregated tenant_headroom_pct dashboards + alert gating. Step 3: ramp to 100% if no elevated FAILED spikes. Kill-switch: immediate disable via flag; alert on >2% absolute increase in user-visible FAILED or if median retry_after_ms > 120s.

Owen Hsu: Console asks: include badge mapping table and accessible color keys. Proposed: OK -> badge_color_key.success, RETRYABLE/THROTTLED -> badge_color_key.warning_high_contrast (amber + pattern), FAILED -> badge_color_key.danger_high_contrast (red + pattern). Also include tooltip copy keys per state.

Felix Martin: Implementation note: do not put route_category as primary metric to avoid high-cardinality in the metrics back-end. Use it as a facet in traces and aggregated dashboards. Keep tenant_headroom_pct as a percentile histogram.

Nina Park: I'll draft RFC with schema, telemetry names, badge mapping table, and migration checklist (server flagging, SDK parsing, console i18n keys). Draft ETA: tomorrow EOD.

Owen Hsu: I'll own SDK changes and tests. Felix, can you wire the dashboard widgets and alerts after RFC?

Felix Martin: On it. Ping when RFC lands.

Nina Park: RFC path: rfc/1742101111-client-surface-and-accessible-badging.md. Linking once posted. Thanks! :seedling:
